purpose: Till the Verdict Do Us Part, season one (episodes 1–60): the shared look, character appearances (English prompts for image and video models), voices, extras, sets and props. Every episode's video.json copies the characters it uses from here (id, name, appearance, voice; costume changes through shot_looks) and never rewrites them, so faces do not drift. Story facts come from ../season-01.json and ../GLOSSARY.md.
owner_notes: Owner 2026-11-09/10: 9:16 vertical (changed from 16:9 on 2026-11-10); season one only, 60 episodes; English written natively, not dubbed from Mandarin.
plan.json: episodes 90–180 seconds, chapter finales at least 120; 3–5 hooks an episode; production on MiniMax Hailuo image-to-video, photoreal live-action, diverse Western cast.

setting.json advertiser_safety and glamour: no blood, no medical procedure, no violence toward people, no bed scenes, no bare backs or low necklines; glass is smashed only when it is a fake, in gloves and goggles, into a steel drum; beauty is in faces, hands and furnace light.
No readable text is ever generated in an image or clip: documents, signs, receipts, ledgers and the bubble name are blank or illegible in generation; any words the viewer must read are added in post.

Owner 2026-11-10: dialogue follows the built-in route of 種田 and 恁祖媽: silent H3 clips, voices from the site's Gemini TTS, no lip-sync model; the on-screen speaker is written 'mouth talking', lines often sit on reaction shots marked off-screen.

Owner 2026-11-10 ('照內建的'): voices are the cast.json defaults (Nora Despina, Elias Charon, Grant Algieba, Peg Gacrux); portraits are the screen-test default picks in assets/refs/ (Nora b, Elias a, Grant a, Peg a). Other characters get portraits when first drawn.

look.style: photorealistic live-action modern American drama, film still, natural cinematic light, realistic skin and fabric texture, soft flattering light on faces, shallow depth of field; Pacific Northwest overcast grey-blue daylight and rain in season one; the Glass House cold blue and reflective; the Ashford house grey concrete with warm pools of lamplight; Remelt Studio warm orange furnace glow against cold window light
look.negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, plastic CG look, text, letters, words, readable signs, subtitles, watermark, logo, brand names, license plates, extra fingers, deformed hands, blood, gore, injury, medical procedure, ultrasound screen, nudity, cleavage, low neckline, bare back, see-through clothing, wet clothes, bed scene, fantasy glow effects, sparkles
look.motion: Natural, realistic human motion; one clear action per clip; faces, clothes, scars and props stay the same; glass and molten glass move with real weight and heat shimmer; no morphing, no cuts
